raw_segments.text: Once more, I took off my handkerchief.
Once more, I thought of the cakes of bread in the little shop.
Oh, for but a crust, for but one mouthful to allay the pang of famine.
Instinctively, I turned my face again to the village.
I found the shop again, and I went in, and though others were there besides the woman,
Would she give me a roll for this handkerchief?
